gh search prs --language rust --merged --limit 100 --json number,title,repository,url,closedAt -- "error treated as success"
gh search prs --language rust --merged --limit 100 --json number,title,repository,url,closedAt -- "ignored error"

order: closedAt descending, then reference; duplicates across queries kept once with every query that found them
